```
q12: baseline 0.87 -> 0.71
overall avg: 0.93 -> 0.92
latency p50: 110ms -> 125ms
```

"""
User: "I need help migrating my repo to the new runtime"
Assistant: Extract intent and entities in JSON: {
  "intent": <...>,
  "entities": [<...>]
}
"""

jon: is this model-side or prompt drift? any eval dataset changes?
